literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe C-terminal fusions to CDHR2 (EGFP and HaloTag respectively). Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the CDHR2 C-terminus (residues 1176–1310) lies entirely in the intracellular domain; the transmembrane segment ends at residue 1175 and the cytoplasmic tail runs from 1176 to 1310. A tag appended after residue 1310 is therefore cytoplasmic, not extracellular. Neither line describes a tag on the extracellular domain (residues 21–1154) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 20). No ledger line supports any extracellular surface tag site for CDHR2; zero sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: CDHR2-EGFP C-terminal knock-in mouse (CRISPR/Cas9); tag appended after the last residue (L1310) which lies in the intracellular domain (residues 1176–1310), not on the extracellular face.

Full-length CDHR2-HALO construct with HaloTag at the C-terminus; same intracellular junction after L1310; confirmed to be derived from the same CDHR2-EGFP backbone, reinforcing the intracellular placement.
